deck_adopted.title: Deck, adopted (print)
deck_adopted.summary: 14 pages, Letter landscape. The talk's slides are imposed at the print scale, centered with wide top and bottom margins. Smallest text is 10.12 pt (the source lines). The nearest text is 0.95 in from an edge, and every chart image is 400 ppi. No defects.

1: Title page: name and date only, data line. Clean
2: 130 → 133 with four labeled change bars (storm days gold, SAIFI blue, CAIDI and SAIDI gray). Nothing clipped
The gold storm bar prints as light as the gray bars. Each bar has its own labeled row, so the rule holds
3: Peer quadrant, 11-peer medians 0.93 and 99.5 labeled, Dominion in blue. Labels clear of the points
Dominion's dot is the darkest; median lines visible
4: Storm vs calm bars, 332.8 vs 27.9 with intervals; the 11.9× panel
Storm bar dark, calm bar light
5: Summary-page screenshot of the final template, 400 ppi (cards 2.68M, 144.4, 109.4, 1.320, 53%; 'Minutes per interruption'), with the model and DAX. Screenshot text is small but sharp
6: Pipeline diagram; '31 tests pass: Original build 12 (6 reliability, 3 storm, 3 demand). New tables: 19'
7: Three 30/60/90 columns, equal heights, text inside the boxes
8: Three takeaways, experience map, thank-you line
9: A1: definition boxes and MED text
10: A2: table 2015–2025 with fit notes; 2025 row highlighted
The highlight prints light gray; table clean
11: A3: hour chart, hours ending 1–5 a.m. blue, brackets for 1–5 a.m. and 1–5 p.m.
Blue bars dark, the rest light
12: A4: sources table; test line T1–T6 / T7–T9 / T10–T12 / T13–T31
14: A6: ten largest events with the Isaias curve inset (400 ppi)

deck_public.title: Deck, public (print)
deck_public.summary: 14 pages, Letter landscape, the same layout as the adopted deck. Smallest text is 10.12 pt and the nearest text 0.95 in from an edge. Chart images are 400 ppi; the report screenshot on slide 5 is 305 ppi. No defects. The slide 3 chart was also checked at 200 dpi: the two 'median of the 12 (including Dominion)' labels sit clear of every point and label.

4: Storm scatter with the 2015–2024 fit and 2025 labeled; 465 → 796; r = 0.70
The 2025 point is dark, the rest light
5: Frequency chart from the current report's What moved page (305 ppi), with the model and DAX
8: As adopted; the storms-by-county line reworded
14: A6: 12-utility table with 'Mixed' and its footnote
The Dominion row prints light gray; clean

1: Side 1: Q1–Q12 in two columns; [you: …] items highlighted; footer well inside the margin

2: Side 2: Q13–Q24, the five questions to ask and the closing line; some space left under Q18
